instructorNote: Read aloud with the display: the print shop manager says 6 of his 14 employees went back inside "to shut down the presses properly" after fire units walked past, and the EOR is on the phone asking, "Read me the trend again. Is anything vibrating next to that wall right now?" Watch for three things: the SUPT asks Ninth Street Command to clear the print shop and keep it empty, the EOR gives her opinion from the timed trend and takes the existing crack into account, and SAFE calls building official Fiona Castellanos at 937-555-0170. Nobody at Larkspur should call the building INSPECTED, RESTRICTED USE or UNSAFE.
